description: A cross-language gotcha worth an explicit fixture: GraderResult.score must be a number or null, never a boolean. This matters because Python's bool is a subclass of int (isinstance(True, int) is True), so a naive numeric-range check in a Python-based runner could silently accept True/False as scores 1/0 -- and a JS/TS runner using typeof could hit an analogous looseness depending on how the value was coerced upstream. A conformance implementation must REJECT this document structurally (score is not of type number|null), not just range-check it.
